scope: Assistant qualitative audit of explicitly permitted human conversation source candidates; no unlicensed live SNS posts; not formal human evaluation

selection.eligible: TRAIN candidate threads after deterministic source-local family/speaker deduplication; if no TRAIN due unresolved split, source candidates explicitly labelled unassigned, never DEV/TEST
selection.shortfallPolicy: Report actual eligible counts. No content-based redraw, truncation, filtering to flattering samples, or reply replacement. Threads exceeding cap excluded by length only; source bias reported.
selection.familyDefinition: Original linked/duplicated conversation or source-assigned conversation family, not whole transitive cross-split speaker component; component must still be source TRAIN or unassigned, never DEV/TEST. Multiple distinct threads may share speakers within TRAIN; report this dependence.

nonClaims: Style does not prove human authorship or consent
Syntactic reply parent does not prove semantic connection
Assistant ratings are not independent native human evaluation
Task-grounded/persona dialogue is not observed spontaneous SNS conversation
Sample fractions are descriptive of sample only
No generated repair or synthetic gold answers
